candidate_id.description: Required for record_evidence, start_validation, and record_result. For primary-only start_validation, prefer candidate_id alone when the Candidate covers the primary request and current prerequisites are met. Runtime resolves Candidate context; do not repeat endpoint/method or assign runtime identity, infer missing body/auth/credentials/templates, or bypass Generic probe/proposal admission. Example: {"action":"start_validation","candidate_id":"<returned candidate.id>"}

items.description: At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes per concrete value.

probe.description: Generic start needs matching controller-verified action context. Concrete comparison/capture/stop proposal; grants no authority.

attempt_id.description: Runtime ID from start_validation; cannot assign an attempt. record_result only; omit from record_evidence.

related_requests.description: Optional supplementary request associations for start_validation; a single legacy explicit primary association remains valid. Each normalized method and resolved/redacted URL has one association across all roles and required values. Different bodies, payloads or identities on the same key are separate HTTP observations, not associations. This is not a list of baseline/TRUE/FALSE/trigger steps or individual HTTP invocations. required defaults to true, except cleanup defaults to false; cleanup still needs separate authorization. Omit a redundant primary declaration only when the Candidate covers it and no supplementary obligation is lost. Preserve required supplementary evidence; resolve conflicts by restating intent, never invent URLs or auto-merge. For a Candidate POST /comments with supplementary GET /comments/123 readback: {"action":"start_validation","candidate_id":"<returned candidate.id>","related_requests":[{"role":"readback","method":"GET","url":"/comments/123"}]}

evidence_path.description: Project proof; shared Candidate headings; parent observation IDs.

observation_ids.description: Exact HTTP/authoritative evidence IDs matching candidate, attempt and request. Terminal sources: complete, untruncated, completed.

status.description: Registration/list status; not used by record_result. Only start_validation owns validating; never register validating.
